title: all-hands-march-2026-draft
content:
Purpose: draft notes and Q&A for the March 2026 all-hands. Working doc — lots of TODOs and open items.

Agenda (high level):
- CEO welcome + company health (growth, runway, org) — Samira to open (~8 mins)
- Product highlights (hosted API growth, Dedicated traction, Private pilot wins) — Omar (~10 mins)
- Reliability & costs update (SRE + Optimize wins, P99 latency, infra savings) — Lucas (~7 mins)
- Customer stories + partner shoutouts — Priya (~5 mins)
- Roadmap preview (Q2 priorities: Private GA, Dedicated autoscale, compiler improvements) — Eng lead (~8 mins)
- People & org (hiring, new leaders, DEI shoutouts) — People Ops (~5 mins)
- Live Q&A (moderated) — All (~20 mins)

Talking points (product):
- Hosted API: continued steady revenue growth; new usage patterns around streaming + tool-calls. Highlight: 35% QoQ increase in requests from top 20 customers.
- Dedicated: several mid-market customers converted from trials to reserved capacity; emphasize predictable throughput and SLA story. Note: mention one anonymized customer case study (legal in review).
- Private: closed 2 pilots (financial services and healthcare); both on track for security review. Emphasize progress toward Private GA H2.
- Redwood Optimize: early results — batching + cache suggestions showing 15–25% token cost reduction for tested apps. Call out that Optimize will become a paid add-on in the future (TBD timing).

Metrics to call out (short bullets):
- ARR trend (high level): +X% YoY (TBD by finance; placeholder)
- API request growth (top customers): +35% QoQ
- P99 latency hosted: 220ms (improved from 280ms since kernel updates)
- Avg token cost change after Optimize configs: -18% (pilot average)

Reliability & incidents (notes):
- Quick summary of last quarter incidents (2 noteworthy):
  1) Feb 10 throttling incident — root cause: routing policy bug under burst; mitigations: hotfix + fallback policy hardened (SRE).
  2) Jan 5 data-plane encryption config drift — resolved, new audit checks added.
- Emphasize overall SLO adherence improving, but be candid about edge cases.

Org notes / hiring:
- We hired key roles in serving runtime and product (names to announce live).
- Hiring focus: infra reliability engineers, private-deploy customers success reps.
- Reminder: internal referral bonus run-through and timeline.

Q&A (anticipated questions + suggested answers):
- Q: "Are we going to open-source our serving runtime?"
  A: Short answer: not fully. We will continue to contribute pieces, maintain benchmarks and reference apps. Our competitive differentiation is the integrated platform and operational tooling — we will open-source some components but not the entire product. (Note: check with legal/PR before saying anything definitive)

- Q: "When will Private GA be available and what are the costs?"
  A: Targeting H2 2026 for GA. Pricing will be announced closer to GA and will include a platform license plus deployment support. We will provide early pricing guidance to pilots. (Action: sync with sales/pricing, PRD link: confluence:PRIVATE-GA-2026)

- Q: "What are we doing to lower costs for customers?"
  A: Describe Optimize feature set: batching recommendations, KV cache tips, quantization suggestions, model routing policies. Share pilot results: typical 15–25% savings, with opportunities for more at scale.

- Q: "How do we prioritize model support and new features?"
  A: Product and Applied ML rank work by customer impact + unit economics. We maintain a model catalog and run regular evals to prevent regressions. Rollouts use canary and A/B to minimize risk.

Notes to self / TODOs before final slide deck:
- Pull exact ARR number from Finance (Jill) — due 2026-03-02 (missed, need before final).
- Confirm anonymized customer case study wording with Legal — priority.
- Update P99 latency numbers after Monday deploy (SRE to confirm).
- Add slide: "How to ask questions" with Slack channel and anonymous form link.
- Draft email announcement + internal Slack post (Jordan to draft).

Open questions / risks to flag in prep call with Samira:
- Timing of Private GA messaging and any statements about pricing. Legal sign-off needed.
- Messaging around open-source contributions vs proprietary stack — avoid specifics without legal/PR OK.
- Any layoffs/headcount changes? No plans; if there are, this doc must NOT mention — escalate immediately.

Slide structure (rough):
1) Title + welcome
2) Company health + metrics
3) Product highlights (3–4 bullets each Hosted/Dedicated/Private)
4) Reliability snapshot
5) Customer wins
6) Roadmap highlights
7) People & org
8) How to get involved / ask follow-ups
9) Q&A slide with live moderation notes

Presenter notes (Omar):
- Keep product section high-level and concrete: one stat + one customer example per product area.
- Avoid exact revenue figures in talk until Finance confirms. Use % growth instead if necessary.
- For technical slides, use simple visuals (p99 chart + Optimize savings bar chart).

Rough script snippets (for Samira/Omar to adapt):
- "We remain focused on making inference predictable and economical for engineering teams. Last quarter we improved latency and cut pilot customer costs with Optimize suggestions — small changes, big impact for customers."
- "Our goal for this year: make Private GA real for regulated customers while keeping the Hosted API fast and affordable for PLG adoption."

Final checklist (before publish):
- [ ] Finance numbers confirmed
- [ ] Legal approval for customer mentions
- [ ] PR/Comms approve message around open-source
- [ ] Slides finalized and rehearse with presenters
- [ ] Draft email + Slack post ready

Draft email subject ideas (brainstorm):
- "All‑hands: where we are and what’s next — March 2026"
- "Redwood All‑hands — March 2026: product, reliability, people"

Misc notes / scratch ideas:
- Consider short customer video clip for customer story slide (PR/CS to coordinate).
- Could run a 3-question pulse survey after the all-hands to collect feedback — quick win for engagement.

---
Checkpoint: convert to slide deck and assign owners to each slide by 2026-03-04.

Document history: initial draft 2026-02-20 by Omar; collaborative edits 2026-02-24 to 2026-03-03.
